Carol's deck reorganizes the five capability categories into three buyer-facing
chapters — Context, Solution, Proof. Category 2A (Foundation) and 2B (Intelligence)
together restate our two-track thesis in the client's own words, which is why it
is the load-bearing source for the point-of-view report.

Slides 12–18 carry the proof points that hang under Engage / Execute / Extend.
Treat this deck as the client-authored mirror of our framing, not as raw input.
